name.zh-Hant: 帛琉洛克群島南部潟湖
name.zh-Hans: 帛琉洛克群岛南部潟湖

airspace.zh: 帛琉由國家航空局（PNAA）管理；觀光局網站的無人機登記表要求年滿18歲、飛行前至少3天申請，並遵守400呎以下、目視範圍內、遠離機場與人群等規定。實際飛行前請向PNAA確認。
airspace.en: Palau's National Aviation Administration (PNAA) handles drones; the registration form on the tourism site asks for applicants aged 18+, at least three days before the flight, and flights below 400 ft, within sight and away from airports and crowds. Check with the PNAA before flying.

ngerukewid.zh: 烏魯克威德群島（七十島）

peleliu.note: island at the south of the lagoon (Wikidata Q14752295)

title.en: Three Thousand Years of Island Life

tagline.zh-Hant: 洛克群島上的石砌村落、墓葬與岩畫，和村落為何被放棄
tagline.en: Stone villages, burials and rock art in the Rock Islands, and why the villages were left

zh: 這裡是帛琉的南部潟湖，
數百座綠色小島散在藍綠色的海上。
en: This is Palau's Southern Lagoon:
hundreds of green islets scattered over a blue-green sea.

zh: 帛琉語叫它切爾巴切布，
英文稱為洛克群島。
en: In Palauan the islands are Chelbacheb;
in English, the Rock Islands.

zh: 這些島今天幾乎無人居住，
但島上留著三千年左右的人類痕跡。
en: Today the islands are almost uninhabited,
yet they hold traces of some three thousand years of people.

zh: 石砌的村落遺址、墓葬與岩畫，
記錄了小島社群怎麼組織生活。
en: Remains of stonework villages, burial sites and rock art
record how small island communities organised their lives.

zh: 烏魯克塔貝爾是洛克群島中最大的一座島。
en: Ngeruktabel is the largest of the Rock Islands.

zh: 口述歷史認為，史前晚期，
這座島上至少有五個村落。
en: Oral history places at least five villages
on this island in late prehistoric times.

zh: 後來居民北遷到科羅爾與巴伯爾道布，
人口減少主要與戰爭有關。
en: Later its people moved north to Koror and Babeldaob;
the depopulation is linked mainly to warfare.

zh: 十七、十八世紀，群島上的村落陸續被放棄。
en: In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries the island villages were abandoned.

zh: 氣候變化、人口增加與取食方式，
共同壓在這個靠海維生的邊緣社會上。
en: Climate change, population growth and subsistence
all pressed on this marginal marine society.

zh: 這段被放棄的歷史，
是世界遺產列為文化價值的原因之一。
en: That story of abandonment is one reason
the site is listed for cultural as well as natural values.

zh: 往西是烏魯克威德群島，
1956年就劃為野生動物保護區。
en: To the west lie the Ngerukewid Islands,
a wildlife reserve since 1956.

zh: 2012年，洛克群島南部潟湖列入世界遺產，
是帛琉第一處世界遺產。
en: In 2012 the Rock Islands Southern Lagoon was inscribed,
Palau's first World Heritage site.

zh: 它同時符合文化與自然兩類標準，
今天由科羅爾州管理。
en: It meets both cultural and natural criteria
and is now managed by Koror State.

zh: 綠島無聲，島民的歷史就藏在林下的石牆裡。
en: The green islands are silent; their people's history lies in the stone walls under the forest.

tagline.zh-Hant: 科羅爾州巡守員、許可證，與每年十萬以上的遊客
tagline.en: Koror State's rangers, permits, and more than a hundred thousand visitors a year

zh: 科羅爾是潟湖北側的島，
船隻從這裡出發前往洛克群島。
en: Koror lies on the north side of the lagoon;
boats leave from here for the Rock Islands.

zh: 從科羅爾坐船，約四十五分鐘可到水母湖所在的島。
en: From Koror, the island with Jellyfish Lake is about 45 minutes away by boat.

zh: 世界遺產範圍由科羅爾州管理，
劃為「保育區」。
en: Koror State manages the World Heritage area
and zones it as a "Conservation Zone".

zh: 科羅爾州巡守員負責執法，
依據的是1994年的州法規。
en: Koror State Rangers enforce the rules,
based on state regulations of 1994.

zh: 這座島上的海豚灣，
是群島裡唯一有人居住的地方。
en: Dolphin Bay on this island
is the only inhabited place in the Rock Islands.

zh: 帛琉的國家水上公園與巡守員總部，
都設在海豚灣。
en: Palau's national aquatics park and the rangers' headquarters
are both at Dolphin Bay.

zh: 外國遊客進入洛克群島，
要購買洛克群島或水母湖許可證。
en: International visitors need
a Rock Islands or Jellyfish Lake permit.

zh: 在水母湖只能浮潛，
不准水肺潛水。
en: At Jellyfish Lake snorkelling is allowed,
but scuba diving is not.

zh: 氣瓶的氣泡會傷到水母，
湖底的硫化氫也會經皮膚吸收。
en: Tank bubbles can harm the jellyfish,
and hydrogen sulphide below can be absorbed through the skin.

zh: 2000年，群島的遊客約五萬八千人；
2015年增加到十六萬多人。
en: Visitors numbered 58,000 in 2000
and more than 160,000 by 2015.

zh: 每年約十萬六千到十三萬八千人。
en: From 2021 to 2023
the yearly total was between about 106,000 and 138,000.

zh: 熱門潛點附近，
潛水活動的影響已經看得出來。
en: Around the most popular dive sites
the impact of diving is already visible.

zh: 2022到2027年的管理計畫，
正在處理這些壓力。
en: A management plan for 2022 to 2027
is addressing these pressures.

zh: 許可證、巡守與分區，
讓遊客和潟湖能長久共處。
en: Permits, patrols and zoning
are how visitors and the lagoon can share the future.

tagline.zh-Hant: 潟湖裡的珊瑚與魚類，和與外海隔開的海水湖
tagline.en: The corals and fish of the lagoon, and lakes cut off from the sea

zh: 從空中看，淺色的礁盤襯著深藍的水道。
en: From the air, pale reef flats lie against deep blue channels.

zh: 潟湖裡記錄到三百八十五種以上的珊瑚，
魚類有七百四十六種。
en: More than 385 coral species are recorded in the lagoon,
and 746 species of fish.

zh: 還有十三種鯊魚與魟類，
以及兩種列入紅皮書的海龜。
en: There are also 13 species of sharks and rays
and two marine turtles on the IUCN Red List.

zh: 2019年，在一處海洋保護區
曾數到多達五百二十一隻儒艮。
en: In 2019 up to 521 dugongs were counted
in one marine protected area.

zh: 群島裡藏著五十二座海水湖，
比世界上任何地方都多。
en: The islands hold 52 marine lakes,
more than any other site in the world.

zh: 最有名的是埃爾馬爾克島上的水母湖。
en: The best known is Jellyfish Lake, on Eil Malk.

zh: 湖面約五點七公頃，平均深三十公尺，
只靠三條石灰岩隧道與海相通。
en: The lake covers about 5.7 hectares and averages 30 metres deep,
linked to the sea only by three tunnels in the limestone.

zh: 湖水上層有氧，到十五公尺左右降為零；
更深處充滿硫化氫。
en: The upper water holds oxygen down to about 15 metres;
below that it is full of hydrogen sulphide.

zh: 金色水母每天白天，
在湖的東西兩端之間來回移動。
en: Each day the golden jellyfish migrate
between the eastern and western ends of the lake.

zh: 1998年聖嬰現象使湖水變暖，
水母一度完全消失。
en: In 1998 an El Niño warmed the lake
and the jellyfish disappeared completely.

zh: 2000年水母重新出現，
2012年回到下降前的數量。
en: They reappeared in 2000
and were back to earlier numbers by 2012.

zh: 這一帶有四千九百多公頃列為重要野鳥棲地，
支撐了帛琉大多數的特有鳥類。
en: Some 4,912 hectares here are an Important Bird Area,
supporting most of Palau's endemic birds.

zh: 氣候變遷帶來的白化與海平面上升，
被視為未來最大的威脅。
en: Bleaching and sea-level rise from climate change
are seen as the greatest future threat.

zh: 小島上的森林，水下的珊瑚，
是同一個生態系統的兩面。
en: The forest on the islands and the corals beneath them
are two sides of one ecosystem.

tagline.zh-Hant: 石灰岩小島的形狀、大小與分布
tagline.en: The shape, size and spread of the limestone islets

zh: 南部潟湖的世界遺產範圍，
面積十萬零兩百公頃。
en: The World Heritage area of the Southern Lagoon
covers 100,200 hectares.

zh: 範圍內有四百四十五座無人居住的石灰岩島。
en: It includes 445 uninhabited limestone islands.

zh: 它們分布在北邊的科羅爾
與南邊的貝里琉之間。
en: They spread between Koror in the north
and Peleliu in the south.

zh: 許多小島像一朵蘑菇，
靠近水面的底部比上面窄。
en: Many islets are shaped like mushrooms,
narrower at the waterline than above.

zh: 潮間帶的凹槽是被啃出來的：
海綿、雙殼貝、石鱉、螺與海膽一點點侵蝕。
en: The intertidal notch is grazed away
bit by bit by sponges, bivalves, chitons, snails and urchins.

zh: 烏魯克威德有三十七座小島，
大多是抬升的珊瑚礁。
en: Ngerukewid has 37 islets,
mostly small raised coral islands.

zh: 最小的只有零點一公頃，
全部加起來不到一平方公里。
en: The smallest is just 0.1 hectares;
together they cover less than one square kilometre.

zh: 往東，是群島中最大的烏魯克塔貝爾。
en: To the east is Ngeruktabel, the largest of the group.

zh: 它的面積約十八點六平方公里，
最高點約兩百一十五公尺。
en: It covers about 18.6 square kilometres
and rises to about 215 metres.

zh: 往南是埃爾馬爾克島，
島中央藏著水母湖。
en: South lies Eil Malk,
with Jellyfish Lake at its heart.

zh: 湖底的隧道穿過中新世古珊瑚礁的石灰岩。
en: Its tunnels run through limestone from an ancient Miocene reef.

zh: 冰河期後海平面上升，
海水灌進窪地，湖約有一萬兩千年。
en: After the ice age the rising sea filled the hollow;
the lake is about 12,000 years old.

zh: 潟湖的南端是貝里琉島。
en: At the southern end of the lagoon is Peleliu.

zh: 抬升的珊瑚礁、海水與時間，
雕出了這片蘑菇島群。
en: Raised reef, seawater and time
carved this field of mushroom islands.

sources.title: IUCN World Heritage Outlook: Rock Islands Southern Lagoon
UNESCO: Rock Islands Southern Lagoon, the first site in Palau inscribed on the World Heritage List
